BEGIN
DEFAULT
RES Execute
RES
RES Execute
NORES
Workbench3.1:C/Execute
ALL
RES Execute
Workbench3.1:C/Execute
Workbench3.1:C/Execute
END

observations: After Path C: and Resident >NIL: C:Execute PURE, C:Which Execute emits RES Execute followed by LF.
C:Which Execute RES emits the same RES Execute line.
C:Which Execute NORES emits Workbench3.1:C/Execute followed by LF.
C:Which Execute ALL emits RES Execute first, then Workbench3.1:C/Execute twice, each followed by LF.
The fixture reaches END after Resident >NIL: Execute REMOVE. Under FailAt 20 this proves only that the four query invocations did not return 20 or above.
limits: The startup sequence and output target are authored probe content on a disposable ADF copy.
This does not establish exact return levels, IoErr, diagnostics, current-directory precedence, disabled/system residents, conflicting switches, parsing failures, cancellation, or MorphOS behavior.
Neither the original ADF nor its C/Which bytes are copied into this repository.
